name: Kashmir
tagline: Houseboat mornings on Dal Lake, gondola afternoons above the snowline
hero_description: Kashmir's valley runs on two seasons' worth of magic: spring shikara rides past Dal Lake's floating gardens and the 400-year-old Mughal terraces above it, then winter's transformation of Gulmarg into India's premier ski slope — served by one of the world's highest cable cars. Between them sit pine-valley walks at Pahalgam and autumn's red-gold chinar turn.
best_time_to_visit: April to June for blooming gardens and lake season; late December to February for snow and skiing at Gulmarg — and late October catches the chinar colour plus the saffron bloom at Pampore.

top_attractions.name: Dal Lake
top_attractions.description: Srinagar's floating world — cedar houseboats, shikara water-taxis seating four to six, vegetable gardens that literally float, and a dawn market conducted entirely from boats.

top_attractions.name: Gulmarg Gondola
top_attractions.description: One of the world's highest cable cars, climbing in two stages from Gulmarg via Kongdoori to nearly 3,950 m on the Apharwat ridge — ski terrain in winter, wildflower meadow in summer.

top_attractions.name: Mughal Gardens of Srinagar
top_attractions.description: Shalimar Bagh (laid out under Emperor Jahangir in 1619) and Nishat Bagh (1633) step down in fountain-fed terraces toward Dal Lake, backed by chinar trees.

top_attractions.name: Pahalgam
top_attractions.description: The 'Valley of Shepherds' on the Lidder River — pine-forest pony trails fan out to Betaab Valley and the village of Aru.

top_attractions.name: Sonamarg
top_attractions.description: The 'Meadow of Gold' at about 2,700 m — the summer walk to Thajiwas Glacier starts here.

top_attractions.name: Saffron fields of Pampore
top_attractions.description: One of the world's few saffron-growing regions — for two weeks from late October the fields turn purple with crocus bloom.

activities: A night aboard a Dal Lake houseboat
Dawn shikara ride to the floating vegetable market
Riding both stages of the Gulmarg Gondola
Skiing or snowboarding at Gulmarg in winter
Pony trek from Pahalgam to Betaab or Aru valley
Mughal gardens circuit — Shalimar, Nishat, Chashme Shahi
Wazwan feast with kahwa tea to finish
Autumn walk under turning chinar trees
